metadata.task_description:
GOAL: 创建交互式影响图谱 (Entity Impact Graph) - 力导向图可视化新闻实体与金融标的之间的关联关系
SCOPE: 1) 节点类型：新闻关键人物/机构 (from ProcessedItem Entities) + 金融标的（股票/大宗商品 from Akshare Data）; 2) 连线逻辑：基于共现频率或时间相关性（Correlation Analysis）; 3) 交互功能：用户可直观看到实体如何通过板块传导影响价格
CONTEXT: 系统已有新闻实体数据 (Entities in ProcessedItem) 和金融行情数据 (Akshare Data)，需要创建可视化组件展示两者关联

project_context.description: A modular monolith news aggregation and economic data monitoring platform with multi-tenant architecture. Features web crawling pipeline (Crawl4AI), news processing with LLM analysis, economic data tracking via AKShare, real-time dashboards with customizable widgets, and multi-channel alerting system. Built as a monorepo using Turborepo with NestJS backend API and Next.js frontend.

patterns: CQRS-lite with GraphQL queries and REST mutations
Event-driven processing with BullMQ job queues
Repository pattern via Prisma and Mongoose

naming_patterns: Use camelCase for variables and functions (e.g., getUserName, isActive)

contains: Entity data structure for news entities

source_code.notes: ECharts wrapper with lazy loading, theme registration, event handling - must extend for graph series type
Dynamic import wrapper for SSR-safe chart rendering
GraphQL model exposing entities as string[] - API contract for entity data
Financial data service with category-based queries - source for financial instrument nodes
GraphQL resolver for economic data queries - pattern for new entity-financial correlation endpoint
Existing correlation analysis service - potential backend for entity-financial correlation
Main dashboard layout - integration point for new EntityImpactGraph component
Reference implementation for dashboard chart with click events, tooltips, CSV export
Hook pattern for fetching economic data - reference for useEntityImpactGraph hook
Chart theming hook with CSS variable integration
Items resolver that normalizes and returns entities - existing API for entity data

config.notes: Backend dependencies - no statistics/correlation library currently installed

external.usage: Visualization library - supports graph series type for force-directed layout (built-in, needs dynamic module installation)
REST API data fetching and caching

breaking_changes: ECharts graph series type needs explicit module loading in echart.client.tsx
GraphQL schema extension needed for full entity objects with type/confidence
New correlation service/endpoint required for entity-financial relationships

conflict_detection.mitigation_strategy: Incremental implementation: 1) Add graph series support to ECharts wrapper, 2) Create new GraphQL query for entity-financial correlation, 3) Build EntityImpactGraph component following existing chart patterns, 4) Integrate into dashboard layout

summary.key_patterns: Monorepo with apps/api (NestJS) and apps/web (Next.js). Dashboard visualization uses ECharts with lazy loading. Data flows through GraphQL queries.
summary.integration_points: Frontend: echart.client.tsx (add graph series), dashboard-content.tsx (add component). Backend: new resolver for entity-financial correlation.

summary.key_patterns: ECharts 5.5.0 supports graph series natively. No additional dependencies required for basic force-directed graph.
summary.integration_points: DashboardChart component needs graph module loading. Backend needs correlation calculation logic.

summary.key_patterns: Entity Data Pattern: ProcessedItemEntitySchema with {name, type, confidence}. ECharts Component Pattern: DashboardChart wrapper with dynamic imports. Data Fetching Pattern: Custom hooks wrapping useQuery.
summary.integration_points: Extend items.resolver.ts or create new resolver. Create custom hook similar to useEconomicData.

summary.key_patterns: Dynamic imports with next/dynamic. ECharts wrapper with lazy module loading. GraphQL hooks from generated types.
summary.integration_points: UI: dashboard-content.tsx grid section. Data API: new GraphQL query getEntityImpactGraph. Chart: extend echart.client.tsx installOnce for graph type.

conflict_indicators.description: ECharts graph series type not in ensureOptionModules - needs addition
No existing entity-financial correlation API - requires new GraphQL query and backend service
Entity data is string[] in GraphQL without structured metadata (type/confidence) - may need schema extension

clarification_needs.question: Which visualization library should be used for the force-directed graph?
clarification_needs.context: ECharts is already installed and supports graph/force series natively. Adding D3.js or vis-network would introduce new dependencies.
clarification_needs.decision: ECharts graph series - consistent with existing codebase, no new dependencies

clarification_needs.question: How should entity-financial correlation be calculated?
clarification_needs.context: System has news entities and financial data but no existing correlation logic.
clarification_needs.decision: Hybrid approach - combine co-occurrence frequency with correlation strength for comprehensive relationship mapping

clarification_needs.question: Should entity type information be exposed in the graph?
clarification_needs.context: ProcessedItemEntitySchema has type field but GraphQL only exposes entity names as string[].
options: Extend GraphQL schema for full entity objects
clarification_needs.decision: Extend GraphQL schema - expose full entity objects with type/confidence for richer node styling

clarification_needs.question: Where should the Entity Impact Graph be placed in the dashboard layout?
clarification_needs.context: Dashboard has 3-column grid with WarMap, SectorHeatmap, GlobalSentimentTrend, FinancialCandlestick.
options: Add as new row below existing charts
clarification_needs.decision: New row below existing charts - prominent visibility while maintaining dashboard integration

constraints.constraint: ECharts graph series requires explicit module installation via installOnce pattern
Components must use 'use client' directive and dynamic imports for SSR safety
No D3.js or vis.js in current dependencies - must use ECharts for consistency
Entity extraction quality varies (confidence 0-1) - may need filtering threshold
Large entity counts may impact force-directed layout performance - consider node limit or clustering

all_patterns.patterns: ECharts lazy-loading pattern: installOnce() for dynamic module loading, ensureOptionModules() for auto-detecting required chart types
Entity Data Pattern: ProcessedItemEntitySchema defines entities with {name: string, type: string, confidence: number}
Chart Component Pattern: useQuery + apiClient + DashboardChart + CSV export + click interactions
Data Fetching Pattern: Custom hooks wrap useQuery, transform data into series maps
State Management Pattern: Zustand stores for shared state, React useState for local state

all_integration_points.points: Frontend Chart Registration: apps/web/components/echart.client.tsx - add 'graph' case to switch statement
Dashboard Layout: apps/web/app/(app)/dashboard/dashboard-content.tsx - add EntityImpactGraph in grid section
Backend API: Create new endpoint at apps/api/src/modules/dashboard/dashboard.controller.ts or new GraphQL resolver
Entity Data Source: ProcessedItem.result.entities from MongoDB via ProcessedItemModel
Financial Data Source: AkshareResponse via AkshareService.getDataByCategory or existing GraphQL queries
